loss_diagnosis.scope: Focused CPU/interpreter diagnosis. Original Round 5 kernels, tests, gates and failures remain unchanged. No CUDA execution or accepted replacement.
conclusions: The observed saturated target-gradient discrepancy is exactly explained by a one-ULP NumPy-versus-PyTorch exponential difference amplified by actual scale/denominator.
The blocked normalizer's tiny logp difference does not alter native CPU half gradients in this diagnostic.
The tie-case native entropy drift is primarily inherited from the CPU forward normalizer; a source-motivated 16-lane accumulation reproduces that normalizer exactly on the recorded CPU.
Substitution diagnostics are not modified-kernel passes. GPU exp, log, reduction order and contraction remain unmeasured.

loss_probe_compile.scope: Offline SM75 compilation only; three math choices for an original diagnostic probe, not a production loss or GPU numerical result.
